parameters.name: Mobile
parameters.description:
The phone number. Valid values:
- If ParamType is set to normal, pass in the phone number in plaintext.
- If ParamType is set to md5, pass in the MD5-encrypted phone number.

parameters.name: ParamType
parameters.description:
The encryption method. Valid values:
- normal: plaintext without encryption
- md5: MD5 encryption.

parameters.name: RegisterDate
parameters.description: The registration date in the format YYYYMMDD. For example, 19800101 indicates January 1, 1980.
